name: Notifications
tip: Fire notifications of every flavour. Useful to verify level colours, stacking, auto-dismiss timings, and system-tray routing.

children.name: Levels
children.tip: One button per level. Title-only, in-app scope.

children.name: notify-info
children.label: Info
children.tip: Fires a title-only info-level notification.

children.name: notify-success
children.label: Success
children.tip: Fires a title-only success-level notification.

children.name: notify-warning
children.label: Warning
children.tip: Fires a title-only warning-level notification.

children.name: notify-error
children.label: Error
children.tip: Fires a title-only error-level notification. 6-second auto-dismiss.

children.name: With body
children.tip: Level + title + multi-line body.

children.name: notify-body
children.label: Info + body
children.tip: Info-level notification with a body paragraph.

children.name: notify-error-body
children.label: Error + body
children.tip: Error-level notification with a body paragraph.

children.name: Scope
children.tip: Which backend(s) receive the notification.

children.name: notify-system
children.label: System tray only
children.tip: Skips the in-app overlay, goes straight to notify-send / osascript.

children.name: notify-both
children.label: In-app + system
children.tip: Shown both in the overlay and in the OS notification area.

children.name: Stacking
children.tip: Fire multiple notifications in a burst to see them stack in the overlay.

children.name: notify-stack
children.label: Fire 5 in a row
children.tip: Emits 5 notifications of mixed levels as fast as possible. The in-app overlay should show them stacked, newer ones below older ones.

name: Events
tip: Exercise the cross-wapp event bus and host → wapp triggers. Each received event is surfaced as an in-app notification so you can see the pipeline working end-to-end.

children.name: Local pub/sub
children.tip: Subscribe to a topic, publish to it, and see the event come back as a notification.

children.name: event-sub-hello
children.label: Subscribe test.hello
children.tip: hal_event_subscribe(test.hello)

children.name: event-pub-hello
children.label: Publish test.hello
children.tip: hal_event_publish(test.hello, greetings). Subscribe first or nothing receives it.

children.name: event-unsub-hello
children.label: Unsubscribe test.hello
children.tip: hal_event_unsubscribe(test.hello). Subsequent publishes are dropped.

children.name: event-echo
children.label: Full echo (sub + pub)
children.tip: Subscribes to test.echo, publishes to it, and drains the result. Should produce one notification in under 500ms.

children.name: Host triggers (via HostEventBridge)
children.tip: Subscribe to the system.* topics that the host republishes from its own EventBus. Useful for reacting to wapp lifecycle or error events from inside a wapp.

children.name: event-sub-wapp-loaded
children.label: Subscribe system.wapp.loaded
children.tip: Fires whenever any wapp finishes its module_init. Open another wapp from the launcher to see it.

children.name: event-sub-wapp-unloaded
children.label: Subscribe system.wapp.unloaded
children.tip: Fires when a wapp page is disposed.

children.name: event-sub-error
children.label: Subscribe system.error
children.tip: Fires whenever an ErrorEvent is published on the host EventBus.
